description: Owner-approved retirements of stale stored (uploaded) translations. For a listed coordinate and locale, a stored translation published before retireStoredBefore is not shown when a learner-ready Git locale file for the same lesson exists; the committed Git file is served instead. Uploads published on or after retireStoredBefore are shown normally. Remove an entry to restore the previous behavior.
